description: Manages files and associated metadata linked to various entities like partners, contacts, or interactions. This includes retrieving, updating, and associating documents.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves all documents associated with a specific entity (partner, contact, or interaction) with access control.

entityId.description: Entity ID to get documents for

example_uses: Find all documents for this partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to see documents, files, or attachments for a specific partner, contact, or interaction.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific document by ID with complete details including file information, metadata, and download access.
example_uses: Show me details for document ID 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific document details by ID or when you need complete document information for viewing or downloading.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing document's metadata, description, and properties with permission validation.

Id.description: The ID of the document to update.

DocumentTypeId.description: The ID of the document type.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change document information or metadata.
